notes.title: The Coffee Boost
notes.content:
[h3]What is the Coffee Boost?[/h3][p]In the exploration segments of 1000 Deaths, you may have noticed the Coffee Cups that you can collect if you approach. What these cups do is give you a boost so that you can quickly run through exploration segments.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="rOTxWV9iPeM;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]The Coffee Cup Collectible can be found in several locations in the game, with the first one in Nowherestown. Use it to speedrun through exploration segments when you are doing a full game speedrun.
[/p][h3]How did we create it?[/h3][p]Interestingly, this collectible was not a feature we had planned on. During development, one of the developers realized that she had to run the same route hundreds of times to check the game. To speed things up, she added a sprint feature that made the characters run comically fast. We then decided to implement the “Coffee” pickup in the game, so that you can unlock this high-speed sprint we had initially used for development! 
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44731477/f330c0a2fdc74925b30d12190c85dbb502a791e1.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44731477/659dee3cb64167b73e0fc0cde61a3ac216e1467d.png"][/img]
[/p][p]Drink that coffee and start speedrunning![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h3]Join the 1000 Deaths Community!
